== Original post ==

'''This Sabbacc is getting worse all the time'''
* '''Author:''' Mike "Kessling" Kessling
* '''Published:''' December 18, 1999
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' This is an ECC/Sabbacc deck. It is untested.

=== Strategy ===

Pretty obvious. Use the Sentinels and the cannons to blow up xwings and lando.

Ops No one in my area uses them, but i think it can beat them 1 out of 2.

==== Mains ====

Battle, retrieve, etc...
